name: phonectl
description: Control your real Android phone from your computer: live browser dashboard, CLI, and an agent-friendly build → screenshot → verify loop. Wireless, over adb + scrcpy.

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('src')) if (f.endsWith('.mjs')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'src/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
